title: Cutover state
description: The fleet's cutover.json: the five freeze switches and what each of them records. Kernel plan M4, M4-P25 acceptance criterion 4.

switches.description: One record per switch. The five names are a CLOSED list: a sixth name is a plan revision, not a document edit, because every rollback trigger enumerates them.

state.description: Which process holds the authority this switch governs.

flippedAt.description: When the switch was last written, as an ISO 8601 instant.

flippedBy.description: Who or what performed the write.

restoreTo.description: The value the switch held before the write; rollback reads it, so a record without it cannot be rolled back.
